licences.Sodir FactMaps: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD), https://data.norge.no/nlod/en
licences.GEM GGIT: CC BY 4.0. Global Energy Monitor, Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker, Gas Pipelines, December 2023 release (Europe Gas Tracker 2024-05). Used only to cross-check landfalls; no GEM geometry or attributes are redistributed.
licences.Reference sites: Published site coordinates cited per terminal; used only to measure distances.

rules.pipelines: Sodir layer 311 transportation pipelines in phase IN SERVICE or INSTALLATION with published geometry; DECOMMISSIONED and ABANDONED IN PLACE excluded.
rules.geometry: WGS84 as published by Sodir; coordinates rounded to 5 decimals, consecutive duplicate vertices dropped, parts with fewer than two distinct vertices dropped; orientation as published.
rules.length_km: Sum of WGS84 ellipsoidal (Vincenty) segment lengths of the published track, 1 decimal. Sodir omits track within 500 m of facilities and publishes some routes schematically, so lengths can differ slightly from nominal pipeline lengths.
rules.status_since: pplCurrentPhaseFromDate as a calendar date in Europe/Oslo.
rules.display_rank: 3 for named trunk lines of at least 16 in and receiving terminals, 2 for other lines of at least 28 in, 1 for at least 16 in, else 0.
rules.receiving_terminals: End vertex of each line whose Sodir destination is a delivery point outside Norway, assigned to the nearest RECEIVING_TERMINALS point (within 20 km); approximate when the Sodir point or an independent check is more than 5 km away.

receiving_terminals.note: Europipe Receiving Facilities. Sodir names EMDEN as the destination of Europipe I and II; the published tracks end at the Dornum landfall, and Europipe I gas continues 48 km onshore to the Emden metering station (Wikipedia: Europipe I; SNL: Dornum gassterminal).

Gassco gives the Dunkerque terminal address as Route de la Warlande, ZIP de Mardyck, Loon-Plage, west of Dunkirk, beside the pipeline end. The Sodir layer 307 point lies east of Dunkirk and is likely in error.
The Sodir track and layer 307 point both lie west of the Seal Sands oil terminal; Sodir also records the nation of this point as Norway.
Gassco places the Zeepipe Terminal in the Zeebrugge port area, about 5 km from the landing site. Sodir also lists ZEEPIPE TERMINAL 20 m from its ZEEBRUGGE point.
